action_items: User must perform ONE more 'Save to GitHub' so the updated .github/workflows/sync-whitelabel.yml (with on: push) lands on GitHub main — after that save, every subsequent save will auto-run the sync.
That first save itself WILL trigger the sync because the save's diff includes .github/workflows/sync-whitelabel.yml + scripts/* (not in paths-ignore).
Optional: document the WL_AUTO_SYNC repo variable (Settings → Actions → Variables, set to 'false' to pause auto-sync) in README/memory.
critical_code_review_comments: FIX 1 verified statically: `on: push: branches:[main]` with paths-ignore (memory/**, .emergent/**, test_reports/**, investigations/**, **.md) plus workflow_dispatch. actionlint exit 0, yaml.safe_load parses cleanly.

Job-level `if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || vars.WL_AUTO_SYNC != 'false'` is correct — vars.X unset = '' and '' != 'false' is true, so push runs by default; setting WL_AUTO_SYNC=false pauses push runs while manual dispatch still works.
`MODE_FLAG: ${{ inputs.dry_run && '--dry-run' || '--push' }}` — on push events `inputs.dry_run` is null/empty (falsy) → MODE_FLAG='--push'. Verified by GitHub Actions expression semantics.

Deploy step `if: steps.sync.outputs.pushed == 'true' && steps.sync.outputs.runtime_changed == 'true' && (github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.deploy)` — auto-redeploys on push, honours checkbox on manual.

No loop risk: scripts/sync_whitelabel.py pushes to WhiteLabel using GITHUB_TOKEN; GitHub explicitly does NOT fire `on: push` workflows for GITHUB_TOKEN pushes, and the workflow listens only on main anyway.
`gh workflow run deploy.yml --ref main -f app=app-wl` — permissions block includes `actions: write` (required for workflow_dispatch via GITHUB_TOKEN).
Concurrency `group: sync-whitelabel, cancel-in-progress: false` — queues overlapping saves safely; each run syncs through newest main so nothing is lost.

FIX 2 verified: scripts/sync_whitelabel.py (line ~330) returns 0 with 'No code changes to carry over to WhiteLabel — nothing pushed.' and outputs pushed=false when `ops` is empty. Covered by new harness test T10 (passes).

rca_of_the_issue: User reported 'I saved but it didn't sync'. Diagnosis: Save to GitHub succeeded (GitHub main == workspace HEAD c1709532), workflow 'Sync main → WhiteLabel' is registered & active, but 0 runs existed because the live workflow had `on: workflow_dispatch` only — saves never triggered it. Mitigation (now in workspace, awaiting one more save to land): (1) workflow adds `on: push: branches:[main]` with narrow paths-ignore so only docs-only saves skip; (2) script no longer creates marker-only commits when nothing code-level changed (ops empty → exit 0, pushed=false), so auto-runs on docs-only saves don't flap WhiteLabel. The user's next 'Save to GitHub' will deliver the push trigger AND, because the save's diff touches the workflow and scripts (not paths-ignored), that very save will fire the first automatic sync.
